findings.claim: The new clause says a tree whose blobs pass 256 MiB is refused. The bound applies to the whole `git cat-file --batch` stdout, which also carries one header line per blob, so the effective ceiling is slightly below 256 MiB of blob bytes. The wording is approximate but not misleading in a user-impacting way.

evidence: The exit-2 claim holds. It rests on a chain of calls, listed here.

`Archive` calls `g.outputStdin` (engine/review/gitexec/gitexec.go:662), which wraps the runner error with `%w` (gitexec.go:901-907). A runner error is `ErrOutputTooLarge` when the bound is passed (engine/execrunner/execrunner.go:126).

`Service.fillCopy` wraps the `Archive` error with `%w` (engine/review/app/sweep.go:279-281). `sweepT2` returns it unchanged (sweep.go:221-228) and `Service.Sweep` returns it unchanged (sweep.go:85-87).
`runReviewSweep` sends any `Sweep` error to `refused`, which exits 2 (engine/cmd/review_sweep.go:84-87, 62-65).

The runner used by the review verbs is `execrunner.New().WithMaxOutput(reviewGitMaxOutput)` with 256<<20 (engine/cmd/review.go:91). `newSweepService` builds on `newReviewService`, so it uses the same git (review_sweep.go:31-41).

Nothing is stored, because `EncodeSweep` and `store` come after the failing step in `Sweep` (sweep.go:94-98). `Archive` writes no file before the `cat-file` answer arrives; the writes happen in the loop at gitexec.go:666-674.

The new real-git test goes through the public `Archive` method. It asserts `errors.Is(err, ErrOutputTooLarge)` and an empty target dir over the bound, and success with the 4001-byte `big.txt` under the bound. At a 2000-byte bound the small `ls-tree` listing passes and the `cat-file` answer (about 4.1 KB) is the one refused, so the test hits the intended path.
The fixture isolates state. It uses `t.TempDir()` for the repo, HOME and XDG_CONFIG_HOME, `GIT_ATTR_NOSYSTEM=1` and `LC_ALL=C` (realgit_test.go:40-56, 215-217). The tests use no network or clock.

The two new stub-runner tests also go through `Archive`. Their short-answer cases and the extra-bytes case match the error paths in `nextBlob` and in the check after the loop at gitexec.go:675-677. I read the first part of `nextBlob`, up to gitexec.go:734, but not the rest of it. I did not run any tests (not run).
`engine/cmd/review.go` changes only a doc comment. The CHANGELOG change is one appended clause.
